funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage in their career; must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any career stage (up to £3,000 and £3,001‑£8,000) and post‑doctoral level for £8,001‑£20,000; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports research travel and/or research time for individuals undertaking research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to students enrolled to start or already undertaking a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing their studies.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Supports research trips to examine 18th‑ and 19th‑century British works on paper.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals with an offer of a master’s degree at a UK institution, start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a master’s degree to bring new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK institution, start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research, covering fees and living expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
